name: All or Nothing

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.desc:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.desc:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accelerated Heatsink
perks.desc: Slightly reduces damage in exchange for improved cooling.

perks.name: Overclocked Heatsink
perks.desc: Slightly increases damage in exchange for reduced cooling.

perks.name: Enhanced Heatsink
perks.desc: Strong battery life. Reduces heat generation.

perks.name: Ionized Heatsink
perks.desc: A large, heavy battery. Increases the time it takes to vent, in exchange for greatly reduced heat generation.

perks.name: Particle Repeater
perks.desc:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Light Heatsink
perks.desc: Lightweight, agile battery. Increases handling and vent speed.

perks.name: Tactical Heatsink
perks.desc: This weapon has multiple small improvements. Slightly improves stability, vent speed, and range.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Cooling Baubles
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Delicate Tuning
perks.desc: While at low heat, this weapon has improved range, handling, and accuracy.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Tear
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed.

perks.name: Desperado
perks.desc: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Thermal Atomization
perks.desc: While at high heat, this weapon deals increased damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.

perks.name: Air-Cooled Core
perks.desc: Sprinting increases vent or reload speed for a short time. While at low heat or full magazine, gain increased handling and movement speed when aiming down sights.

notes: Inspired by @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for Minor add group control in general at-level or better content, particularly on Strand builds. All Or Nothing is a Dynamic Heat pulse rifle which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic, providing an intrinsic ×1.15 damage boost against red-bar enemies and ×1.325 against orange and yellow bars and vehicles, plus a ×0.5 heat generation if you manually cancel a vent animation at <12.5% of maximum heat, as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are decent by comparison with rapid fire pulses, which are the closest comparators - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/3984776322 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. The Handling is on the low side, so use the barrel perk to boost that - although you might want a little extra recoil control or Stability. For the battery perk, Overclocked Heatsink provides free ×1.02 damage for a slightly slower vent speed - not a problem if you manually reload anyway - Particle Repeater helps Stability or Light Heatsink or Tactical Heatsink improve gunfeel. For Strand synergy and add group control, there trait perk pairings that all proc on crit kills - Firefly procs a 4m AoE solar explosion, plus +50 Reload Speed for 6s in the first trait perk column, which you can match with Tear to spreads ~4m AoE sever to reduce damage output to ×0.6 from enemies affected - Firefly widens the Tear AoE further - or Hatchling spawns a Threadling also on a crit kill or on three crit hits within 3s of each other. For the Origin Trait Air-Cooled Core improves handling and ADS speed when heat is <10%, and boosts Vent Speed for 6s after sprinting. If you're very lucky you'll drop a weapon with the much better option of Accelerated Assault which passively reduces heat by 10% and boosts damage by ×1.05 for getting 3 hits within 1.6s. If you're interested, it's modelled on the EE-3 Carbine rifle used by Mandalorian bounty hunter Boba Fett. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost heat generation, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
